verdict.rationale: Make documents a public, authenticated REST API, and its official MCP server gives AI clients scenario management tools to "view and modify scenarios" and "manage the contents of your Make account". Make Skills also help assistants build scenarios. However, the pack contains no explicit scenario create, update or activate API endpoint, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: documented scenario create/update endpoints in the API reference, an explicit activate/deactivate scenario endpoint or tool, and hands-on corroboration of an agent building and activating a scenario end-to-end.
